name: MotherCare Baby Tap to Toe Wash | 300ml
description:
Product details of MotherCare Baby Tap to Toe Wash | 300ml 
Brand: MotherCare 
Product Type: Baby Top to Toe Wash 
Size: 300ml 
Formulation: Gentle, soap-free liquid wash 
Targeted Age Group: Suitable for newborns and babies 
Usage: All-in-one wash for body and hair 
All Mothercare's specialist know-how goes into our All We Know Baby Top to Toe Wash. It is designed to keep your baby's skin feeling soft and moisturized-perfect for baby's bubbly bath times. It is the best way to cleanse your baby's soft skin without drying it. It contains Olive extract, nature's ultimate moisturizer, soothing chamomile and lavender extracts for deep relaxation.
